Errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Invalid credentials or your authentication session has expired.
Errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid request. Check the content and configuration.
Errors.SESSION_BUSY: This conversation is processing another request. Please wait.
Errors.REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS: This request is already processing. Do not resend it with a new ID.
Errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request ID was used for a different payload.
Errors.ATTEMPT_NOT_REPLAYABLE: The earlier attempt ended or was interrupted. Check history before creating a new request.
Errors.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The account or project quota is exhausted.
Errors.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: This request exceeds the remaining budget.
Errors.RATE_LIMITED: Rate limit reached. Wait and check the earlier attempt before retrying.
Errors.PROVIDER_TIMEOUT: The request timed out. Check history before trying again.
Errors.DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: The service is not ready. Please try again later.
Errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Connection lost. Your draft is preserved; retry the same request to avoid duplicate calls.
Errors.OUTPUT_INVALID: The provider returned an invalid response.
Errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Errors.DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE: Document exceeds processing limits. Select smaller or fewer documents.
Errors.DOCUMENT_LIMIT: This conversation has reached its document limit.
Errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_READY: Index the document first; reindex after an embedding revision change.
Errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: Document not found in your conversation.
Errors.NO_EXTRACTABLE_TEXT: No extractable text. Scanned or image PDFs require OCR, which is not supported.
Errors.ENCRYPTED_DOCUMENT: This document is encrypted. Use an unlocked copy.
Errors.FILE_TYPE_INVALID: File content does not match a supported format.
Errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: Use UTF-8 TXT/MD, text PDFs or DOCX.
Errors.DOCUMENT_PARSE_FAILED: Unable to parse this document. Check whether the file is damaged.
Errors.DOCUMENT_PARSE_TIMEOUT: Parsing timed out. Use a simpler or smaller file.
Errors.CONTEXT_OVERFLOW: Sources and history exceed the conservative context bound. Reduce sources or start a new conversation.
Errors.NO_COMPATIBLE_MODEL: No compatible model with verified configuration, access and prices is available.
Errors.DOCUMENT_PROCESSING_FAILED: Document processing did not complete; no full-document result is available.
Errors.PROCESS_INTERRUPTED: Operation interrupted. API calls are not automatically replayed; check usage before creating a new job.
Errors.CATALOG_CHANGED: Catalog changed. Review and create a new run.

MVP.sourceHint: A valid citation alone does not verify answer correctness.
MVP.noDocuments: No documents yet. Upload to begin.
MVP.promptBound: Preflight uses a conservative token bound; provider usage is available after the call.
MVP.noOptimizer: Optimizer algorithms await integration; live currently uses the configured baseline.
MVP.error: Action did not complete. Check its status before retrying.
MVP.jobBudgetHint: Paid calls are blocked when budget is insufficient. Interrupted paid jobs are never automatically rerun.
MVP.sourceMissing: No actual usage for this turn yet.
MVP.billingCorrections: {count} calls have audited billing corrections. Original usage/traces are retained.

Research.title: Model Router experiments
Research.subtitle: Identical inputs. Multiple model-selection policies. Every decision traced.
Research.honest: Fixtures test software only. Simulation has no actual token/USD usage. Live pilots require a separate gate; fixture outcomes do not establish research quality or savings.
Research.noCharge: No quota charge or real model calls.
Research.active: One run is active. Wait for completion or cancel it first.
Research.empty: No runs yet. Select configurations and run preflight.
Research.localTiming: Local trial timing includes routing and mock. Errors include intentional fault fixtures; these are not real model latency or quality measurements.
Research.adminOnly: This account cannot run or view research.
Research.paidWarning: Live charges count against budgets using usage/catalog. This fixture pilot is not qualified research.
Research.liveTiming: Trial timing includes routing and provider, not browser E2E. Fixture outcomes are not research quality evidence.
